instruction: Navigate to the NBA standings page on nba.com.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent started on nba.com and attempted to browse women's Nike jerseys. Clicked Store link which redirected to global.nbastore.com, received HTTP 403 (Access Denied). Spent all 50 turns trying alternative store URLs (shop.nba.com, nba.com/shop, nba.com/store) and Google search, all blocked by network restrictions.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate nba.com homepage, use top navigation bar (Games, Schedule, Stats, etc.), open/manage multiple Chrome tabs, type URLs in address bar, scroll pages, dismiss cookie consent dialogs
metadata.failure_analysis: Model failed because external store sites (global.nbastore.com, shop.nba.com) returned 403 Access Denied due to VM network restrictions. Google search also failed with SSL certificate error. The task was impossible in this environment.
metadata.task_rationale: Simplified to direct navigation within nba.com which was confirmed accessible. Standings page is reachable via the top navigation bar which the model interacted with successfully.
metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to the NBA standings page. Evaluator checks the active tab URL matches the standings page pattern using regex.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter 'active_url_from_accessTree' correctly extracts the active tab URL from the accessibility tree, which is the right state to verify navigation.

Metric 'is_expected_url_pattern_match' correctly receives the rules dict (via type='rule') and accesses rules['expected'] to get the regex pattern list. Logic iterates patterns and uses re.search, which is correct.
Regex pattern 'https://.*nba\.com/standings' correctly matches the expected NBA standings URL (e.g., https://www.nba.com/standings).
Single-step instruction (navigate to standings page) is fully covered by the URL pattern check. No missing verification steps.
Data flow is compatible: getter returns a string URL, metric handles string input via isinstance check.
